summary: Aris Mining filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 7, 2026 news release reporting preliminary Q3 2026 gold production. Q3 output was 69.3 koz, bringing nine-month 2026 production to 217.3 koz, up 16% year over year, with gold sales of 68.4 koz at roughly $4,204 per ounce for about $287 million in quarterly revenue. The company reaffirmed the low end of 300,000–350,000 ounce 2026 guidance and cited the Marmato Cascabel 3 tailings facility commissioning, $419 million cash, and expected November 4 financials. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
